page_title: FIO 2-1 LAZ | Fiorentina v Lazio 22/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) meets a cross inside the box and heads it goalwards. Unfortunately for him, he sends the ball narrowly over the crossbar. What a chance!
90+5' Dodo (Fiorentina) was probably a bit loose with his words to Matteo Marcenaro, who decides to show him a yellow.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' 2 - 1 Goal! Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) calmly steps up and smashes the ball into the roof of the net.
90' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) is going to take the penalty!
90' It’s a PENALTY to Fiorentina after the VAR review!
89' The main referee, Matteo Marcenaro, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) is given a yellow card for dissent.
89' Today's referee Matteo Marcenaro rightly decides to book Nuno Tavares (Lazio) for his harsh tackle.
88' There's a break in play and referee Matteo Marcenaro must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Fiorentina using VAR. This could be interesting!
88' One of the Fiorentina players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
85' Patric (Lazio) sees a yellow card from Matteo Marcenaro after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
85' The corner is swung in but Lazio can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
83' Lazio can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Lazio force their opponents to concede a corner.
83' Pedro (Lazio) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Lazio.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) comes onto the pitch so that Danilo Cataldi can be given a rest.
82' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lazio comes to nothing.
81' Substitution. Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Andrea Colpani walks off.
80' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
78' Fiorentina quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
78' A lofted cross from Dodo (Fiorentina) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is out of play. Fiorentina win a corner kick.
71' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the left post.
70' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the left side of the goal. Ivan Provedel is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
69' Today's match ends for Manuel Lazzari who will be replaced by Adam Marusic (Lazio).
68' Marco Baroni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pedro (Lazio) replacing Boulaye Dia.
66' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
66' The referee points to the corner flag and Fiorentina will take a corner.
65' Here comes a substitution. Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) is brought on as a substitute for Rolando Mandragora.
62' Lazio take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
61' Here is a change. Gaetano Castrovilli is going off and Marco Baroni gives the last tactical orders to Nicolo Rovella (Lazio).
61' Substitution. Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) on for Gustav Isaksen.
57' Patric (Lazio) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
56' Looks like Patric (Lazio) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
55' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) takes it short.
55' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Lazio have been awarded a corner kick.
53' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
49' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Ivan Provedel no chance!
49' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
48' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Penalty awarded! Fiorentina will take a penalty kick.
46' The game is over for Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina). Albert Gudmundsson comes on for the second half.
46' Raffaele Palladino makes a switch. Luca Ranieri is coming on in place of Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
42' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Matteo Marcenaro didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

41' 0 - 1 Superbly taken set piece! Nuno Tavares takes the free kick and sends a cross into the six-yard box. Mario Gila (Lazio) flicks the ball lightly with his head under the goalkeeper's legs. David de Gea can't react quickly enough and the score changes to 0:1.
40' A clumsy foul by Moise Kean (Fiorentina) and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Lazio.

37' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by David de Gea, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
35' Mario Gila (Lazio) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the bottom right corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
34' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

32' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by David de Gea!
32' A sweet pass inside the box gives Moise Kean (Fiorentina) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
30' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
30' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Lazio have been awarded a corner kick.

27' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) latches on to the ball from the corner kick and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. He can't direct his shot goalwards as it goes well wide of the left post.
26' Edoardo Bove (Fiorentina) prepares to take a corner kick.
26' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
23' A cross is slung in towards the penalty spot and Edoardo Bove (Fiorentina) creates space for himself but sends his header inches over the bar.
21' Manuel Lazzari crosses the ball right onto the head of Tijjani Noslin (Lazio), but his firm header from around the penalty spot shoots well wide of the right post.
20' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) launches a cross from the corner, but David de Gea is alert to thwart the effort.

20' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lazio will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

19' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies towards the left side of the goal, but it's kept out by magnificent save from David de Gea.
15' A dangerous looking corner kick from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is cleared to safety by the defence.
13' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
12' Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul. Lazio have a free kick from a promising distance.
11' The free kick is taken by Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio), but ball is cleared.
11' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
9' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the left post. Unlucky!
7' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
7' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Lazio have a corner.
6' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
5' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Lazio have been awarded a free kick.
1' The match has just started.
Fiorentina will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Matteo Marcenaro.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
